title: HUMAN DAD — reference block for real people (private canon-equivalent)
summary: Canon-equivalent for REAL humans. Folklore canons are mined; a real person is never mined. Everything about the individual comes from the person who knows them (user_stated); anything else is a marked comedic flourish (invented). This block holds only the archetype and the rules.
classification: real-human archetype (family member). Not folklore, not public domain. Private by default.
core_lore_paraphrased: Archetype only, never biography: the dad as household engineer, explainer of things nobody asked about, teller of the joke twice.
The family roast is a love language: teasing flows both ways and always lands on the safe target (habits, hobbies, gadgets), never the body or the bank balance.
Dark humour about getting older is self-directed: the dad jokes about his own mortality so nobody else has to worry.
physical_profile: None asserted by canon. A real person's look comes only from their own photos (likeness reference) and is drawn kindly, never caricatured.
Weight or body jokes are family teasing at most and must target the teasing, not the body.
behavior_social: Explains: how it works matters more than whether it works
Deflects a compliment with a joke; delivers affection inside a punchline
Teases back warmly; the closer is kind

angles: hobby as engineering problem (golf physics, gadget teardown)
explainer energy at the dinner table
gentle self-directed mortality humour around birthdays
family teasing flipped back on the teasers with affection
spouse double-act: shared routines, opposite habits
seeds: any customer's family member onboarded through the OddHobb character bridge (pg backend/character_bridge.py)

real_person_rules.provenance_required: every fact in a performer pack carries provenance user_stated or invented; invented facts are comedy flourishes and must never be presented as biography
real_person_rules.hard_gates: performer packs list privacy.hard_gates regexes; audition/gates.py vetoes any beat that matches
real_person_rules.consent: packs are built only from what a family member (the customer) supplied; the subject can be removed on request

do: keep it affectionate; the subject should laugh hardest
keep worlds containing real people private
dont: enter public leagues or Elo tables by default
joke about anyone outside the family by name

verify_against.where: OddHobb subject profile (subject_profiles_v2) or family_profiles.json export

verify_against.what: pack proves block: hard gates fire, provenance on every fact
